map.均值样本量计算器 使用指南: Mean Sample Size Calculator User Guide
map.均值样本量计算器：给定置信水平、容许误差与总体标准差，估计总体均值所需的最小样本: Mean Sample Size Calculator: given the confidence level, the allowable error and the population standard deviation, estimate the minimum sample size needed for the population mean. Useful for experiment design.
map.估计总体均值所需的最小样本量由允许误差 e、总体标准差 σ 与置信水平对应的 z: The minimum sample size needed to estimate a population mean is determined by the allowable error e, the population standard deviation σ and the z value of the confidence level: the smaller the error, the larger the standard deviation and the higher the confidence level, the larger the required sample. The z value can be typed in manually (95% maps to 1.96, 99% maps to 2.576) and the result is rounded up.
map.填写「误差界 e」。: Enter the margin of error e.
map.n=(z·σ/e)²，给定精度 e 与置信。: n = (z·σ/e)², given the precision e and the confidence level.
map.实验设计前规划样本量。: Plan the sample size before the experiment.
map.：e=1：n=(19.6)²=384.16→385，精度翻倍样本量翻四倍。: e = 1: n = (19.6)² = 384.16 → 385. Halving the precision error quadruples the sample size.

map.e 是允许的误差幅度（ME），即置信区间半宽上限；e 越小所需 n 越大（平方关: e is the allowable margin of error (ME), the upper limit of the confidence-interval half-width; the smaller e is, the larger the required n (a square relationship).
map.σ 未知怎么定？: How do I set σ when it is unknown?
map.用预实验/文献估计，或取保守最大变异；否则需两阶段抽样。: Estimate it from pilot work or the literature, or take the most conservative maximum variation; otherwise you need a two-stage sample.
